title: Requesting Employees
description:
Due to your work in the Amber tier, the Moonlit Company has authorized you to make employee requests.

Our employee registration program makes use of [REDACTED]. Due to instability of said program, the intelligence of said employees... Leaves something to be desired.

You may still find them useful, as most abnormalities do not recognize them as souls, and thus are not threat.

Be weary of abnormalities that prefer domination and subjugation as employees are easy targets.
